metadata.title: feat(helm): implement dynamic provisioning for persistent storage
metadata.author: SharkyND

description:
# feat(helm): implement production-ready dynamic storage provisioning

## Overview

This PR builds upon PR [#1307](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/1307) to address the remaining feedback about production readiness and documentation for the new persistence features.

## Changes Made

### Production Storage Implementation
- **Removed hostPath dependency**: Deleted manual PV templates (`postgres-pv.yaml`, `redis-pv.yaml`) that only work on single-node clusters
- **Implemented dynamic provisioning**: Updated PVC templates to remove selectors and rely on StorageClass-based dynamic provisioning
- **Cloud-native compatibility**: Now works seamlessly across AWS EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, and bare-metal Kubernetes

### Enhanced Documentation
- **Comprehensive storage guide**: Added detailed "Storage & Persistence Configuration" section to `charts/README.md`
- **Production examples**: Included storage class examples for major cloud providers:
  - AWS EKS: `gp3`, `gp2`, `io1`, `io2`
  - Google GKE: `standard`, `ssd`, `premium-rw`
  - Azure AKS: `default`, `managed-premium`, `azurefile`
  - Bare Metal: `local-path`, `nfs-client`, `ceph-rbd`
- **Backup & recovery guidance**: Added Velero annotations and best practices

### Schema & Configuration Updates
- **Extended values schema**: Added support for `annotations` and `reclaimPolicy` properties in persistence configuration
- **Improved values.yaml**: Enhanced inline documentation with production storage class examples
- **Validation fixes**: Resolved all schema validation errors reported in the original PR

## Addresses PR Review Feedback

> **hostPath only works for single-node clusters; most production deployments use dynamic provisioning**

✅ **Fixed**: Completely removed hostPath-based manual PV creation. The chart now exclusively uses dynamic provisioning, making it production-ready for multi-node clusters and cloud environments.

> **Missing README/docs update for the new persistence features**

✅ **Fixed**: Added comprehensive documentation covering:
- Dynamic provisioning setup
- Storage class selection for different cloud providers
- Backup and recovery strategies
- Migration guidance from manual PV setups

## Breaking Changes

⚠️ **BREAKING CHANGE**: Manual PV creation with hostPath is no longer supported. Users must rely on dynamic provisioning with StorageClasses.

**Migration Path**:
1. Ensure your cluster has a default StorageClass or specify one in `storageClassName`
2. Remove any manual PV resources if previously created
3. The chart will now automatically provision storage via your cluster's dynamic provisioning

## Testing

- ✅ Helm chart templates successfully with default values
- ✅ Helm chart templates successfully with production configurations
- ✅ Schema validation passes for all supported persistence configurations
- ✅ Helm lint passes without warnings

## Related Issues

Closes #1307
Reference: https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/1308

## Deployment Impact

This change makes the Helm chart more production-ready by:
- Eliminating single-node limitations
- Supporting automatic failover and node scheduling
- Enabling cloud-native storage features (snapshots, encryption, IOPS tuning)
- Providing clear migration paths for existing deployments

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Users can still use manual PVs by creating them separately (not breaking) - I think this is fine, we should address it in the docs that this is still possible.

commits.message:
feat(helm): implement dynamic provisioning for persistent storage

- Remove manual PV templates (postgres-pv.yaml, redis-pv.yaml) that used hostPath
- Update PVC templates to use dynamic provisioning without selectors
- Add production storage class examples in values.yaml for AWS/GKE/Azure
- Extend values.schema.json to support annotations and reclaimPolicy properties
- Add comprehensive Storage & Persistence documentation in charts/README.md

This addresses PR feedback about hostPath limitations in production deployments
and provides cloud-native storage configuration that works across all Kubernetes
environments with proper dynamic provisioning.

BREAKING CHANGE: Manual PV creation with hostPath is no longer supported.
Users must rely on dynamic provisioning with StorageClasses.

Signed-off-by: SharkyND <shahrukh.naveed@live.com>
